blocks.zh: Test A — 容器內表面耐水解性（水蝕試驗）
blocks.en: Test A: Hydrolytic Resistance of the Inner Surfaces of Containers (Water Attack Test)

blocks.zh: Test A測試什麼？
blocks.en: What Does Test A Measure?

blocks.zh: Test A模擬藥液與玻璃內表面的接觸反應：用「水R1」（高純化水）在121°C高壓蒸汽條件下萃取玻璃內表面的可浸出鹼性離子，然後以鹽酸反滴定，量化「鹼性離子釋放量」。數值越低，耐水解性越好。
blocks.en: Test A simulates the reaction between the drug solution and the glass inner surface: "water R1" (highly purified water) is used to extract leachable alkali ions from the inner surface of the glass under autoclave conditions at 121°C, and the extract is back-titrated with hydrochloric acid to quantify the "amount of alkali released". The lower the value, the better the hydrolytic resistance.

blocks.zh: 試驗液體積選取（Table 3.2.1-2）
blocks.en: Selection of Test Solution Volume (Table 3.2.1-2)

blocks.zh: 水R vs 水R1
blocks.en: Water R vs Water R1

blocks.zh:
Water R：一般試驗用水（電導率 ≤ 2 µS/cm）。用於清洗容器（初步）。
Water R1：高純化水（電導率 ≤ 1 µS/cm），pH接近中性，無溶解離子干擾。作為試驗萃取液、末次沖洗及空白對照液——避免水中溶質影響滴定結果。
blocks.en:
Water R: general-purpose test water (conductivity ≤ 2 µS/cm). Used for the initial cleaning of containers.
Water R1: highly purified water (conductivity ≤ 1 µS/cm), near-neutral pH, free of interfering dissolved ions. Used as the extraction solution, for the final rinse and as the blank, so that solutes in the water do not affect the titration result.

blocks.zh: 安瓿的特別說明
blocks.en: Special Notes on Ampoules

blocks.zh: 密封安瓿（closed ampoules）不進行預清洗——因為安瓿在密封狀態下已無塵土污染，且預清洗可能改變內表面狀態。測試前可在約40°C水浴中預熱~2分鐘，防止開口時因內外壓差造成液體噴濺。
blocks.en: Closed ampoules are not pre-cleaned, because a sealed ampoule is already free of dust contamination and pre-cleaning could alter the state of the inner surface. Before testing, the ampoule may be pre-warmed in a water bath at about 40°C for ~2 minutes to prevent the liquid from spraying out when it is opened because of the pressure difference between inside and outside.

blocks.zh: Test A — 高壓滅菌程序
blocks.en: Test A: Autoclaving Procedure

blocks.zh: 標準熱循環（Reference thermal cycle）詳解
blocks.en: The Reference Thermal Cycle Explained

blocks.zh:
升溫至100°C：20–30 min
維持100 ± 1°C：10 ± 1 min（排除不凝性氣體）
升溫至121°C：20–22 min
維持 121 ± 1°C：60 ± 1 min（萃取保溫時間）
降溫至100°C：40–44 min
安全開啟溫度：≤ 95°C
blocks.en:
Heat to 100°C: 20–30 min
Hold at 100 ± 1°C: 10 ± 1 min (to vent non-condensable gases)
Heat to 121°C: 20–22 min
Hold at 121 ± 1°C: 60 ± 1 min (extraction hold time)
Cool to 100°C: 40–44 min
Safe opening temperature: ≤ 95°C

blocks.zh: 這個熱循環設計是為了確保容器內部達到121°C，而非只是高壓滅菌器腔室的溫度——容器和腔室之間可能有顯著溫差，因此必須在容器內部放置熱電偶進行校正。
blocks.en: This thermal cycle is designed to ensure that the temperature inside the container reaches 121°C, not merely the temperature of the autoclave chamber. There can be a significant temperature difference between the containers and the chamber, so a thermocouple must be placed inside a container for calibration.

blocks.zh: 10分鐘維持100°C的目的
blocks.en: Purpose of the 10-Minute Hold at 100°C

blocks.zh: 蒸汽滅菌器的初始階段需要先排除腔室內的不凝性氣體（主要是空氣）。若空氣未排除，蒸汽無法直接接觸容器，導致容器內部溫度低於指定值。在100°C維持10分鐘的目的就是蒸汽置換（Steam purge）——徹底排除不凝性氣體後再加壓升溫。這也是為什麼手動高壓滅菌器要將排氣閥（vent cock）打開讓蒸汽持續排出20–30分鐘。
blocks.en: In the initial phase of a steam sterilizer, the non-condensable gases (mainly air) in the chamber must first be removed. If the air is not removed, steam cannot contact the containers directly, and the temperature inside the containers will be lower than specified. The purpose of the 10-minute hold at 100°C is a steam purge: the non-condensable gases are removed completely before the pressure and temperature are raised. This is also why, with a manual autoclave, the vent cock is opened to let steam escape continuously for 20–30 minutes.

blocks.zh: 「容器內部」溫度校正的重要性
blocks.en: Importance of Calibrating the Temperature "Inside the Container"

blocks.zh: Ph.Eur.特別強調：高壓滅菌器腔室溫度讀數與容器內部水溫之間可能存在顯著差異。CDMO在建立此試驗方法時，必須先完成儀器校正——用熱電偶插入實際容器內部測量，確認腔室設定能使容器內部達到121 ± 1°C，然後記錄校正後的設定值作為常規使用參數。
blocks.en: Ph.Eur. specifically emphasizes that there may be a significant difference between the autoclave chamber temperature reading and the water temperature inside the containers. When establishing this test method, the CDMO must first complete instrument calibration: a thermocouple is inserted inside actual containers to confirm that the chamber setting brings the container contents to 121 ± 1°C, and the calibrated setting is then recorded as the routine operating parameter.

blocks.zh: 試驗 vs 藥品滅菌：同一台設備，不同目的
blocks.en: Test vs Product Sterilization: Same Equipment, Different Purposes

blocks.zh: Ph.Eur. 3.2.1的高壓滅菌是「化學萃取試驗」——目的是讓水與玻璃內表面充分反應，萃取鹼性離子；而藥品的終端滅菌（terminal sterilization）目的是殺滅微生物。兩者使用的溫度相同（121°C），但試驗不需要生物指示劑（BI），只需嚴格控制熱循環曲線確保萃取條件一致。
blocks.en: The autoclaving in Ph.Eur. 3.2.1 is a "chemical extraction test": the aim is to let water react fully with the glass inner surface and extract alkali ions. Terminal sterilization of a drug product, by contrast, aims to kill microorganisms. Both use the same temperature (121°C), but the test does not need a biological indicator (BI); it only requires strict control of the thermal cycle profile to keep the extraction conditions consistent.

blocks.zh: Test A — 滴定方法與驗收限度
blocks.en: Test A: Titration Method and Acceptance Limits

blocks.zh: 反滴定法操作邏輯
blocks.en: Logic of the Back-Titration Procedure

blocks.zh: 1取出後1小時內滴定（防止鹼性離子繼續溶出或揮發影響結果）
blocks.en: 1Titrate within 1 hour of removal (to prevent alkali ions from continuing to dissolve or from volatilizing and affecting the result)

blocks.zh: 2合併各容器萃取液並混合均勻
blocks.en: 2Pool the extracts from the individual containers and mix well

blocks.zh: 3取規定體積作為試驗液；同體積水R1作空白對照
blocks.en: 3Take the specified volume as the test solution; use the same volume of water R1 as the blank

blocks.zh: 4兩者各加入甲基紅指示劑（methyl red）
blocks.en: 4Add methyl red indicator to each

blocks.zh: 5用0.01 M HCl先滴定空白至終點（紅色），記錄體積V₀
blocks.en: 5Titrate the blank with 0.01 M HCl to the end point (red) and record the volume V₀

blocks.zh: 6用0.01 M HCl滴定試驗液至與空白同色，記錄體積V₁
blocks.en: 6Titrate the test solution with 0.01 M HCl to the same colour as the blank and record the volume V₁

blocks.zh: 7淨消耗 = V₁ − V₀，換算為mL/100 mL
blocks.en: 7Net consumption = V₁ − V₀, converted to mL/100 mL

blocks.zh: Table 3.2.1-3限度的設計邏輯
blocks.en: Design Logic of the Table 3.2.1-3 Limits

blocks.zh: 小容量容器（如0.5 mL針劑）的限度比大容量容器更寬鬆（3.0 vs 0.20 mL/100 mL）。這是因為小容量容器的比表面積（surface area / volume ratio）更高——同樣的玻璃品質，萃取出的鹼性離子相對量更大，因此需要設定更高的容許值。Type III的限度約為Type I/II的10倍，反映其僅有中等耐水解性的特性。
blocks.en: The limit for small-volume containers (such as 0.5 mL injection vials) is more lenient than for large-volume containers (3.0 vs 0.20 mL/100 mL). This is because small containers have a higher surface-area-to-volume ratio: for the same glass quality, the relative amount of alkali extracted is larger, so a higher permitted value is needed. The limit for Type III is about 10 times that for Type I/II, reflecting its only moderate hydrolytic resistance.

blocks.zh: Test A計算範例
blocks.en: Test A Worked Example

blocks.zh:
充填容積 = 5.0 mL（1 mL注射劑，10個合併）
試驗液體積 = 50 mL（Table 3.2.1-2，2次滴定）
空白滴定：V₀ = 0.02 mL
試驗液滴定：V₁ = 0.08 mL
淨消耗 = 0.08 − 0.02 = 0.06 mL
換算為100 mL：0.06 × 100/50 = 0.12 mL/100 mL
限度（Type I/II，5 mL充填）= 1.3 mL/100 mL → ✓ 合格
blocks.en:
Filling volume = 5.0 mL (1 mL injection containers, 10 pooled)
Test solution volume = 50 mL (Table 3.2.1-2, 2 titrations)
Blank titration: V₀ = 0.02 mL
Test solution titration: V₁ = 0.08 mL
Net consumption = 0.08 − 0.02 = 0.06 mL
Converted to 100 mL: 0.06 × 100/50 = 0.12 mL/100 mL
Limit (Type I/II, 5 mL filling) = 1.3 mL/100 mL → ✓ Pass

blocks.zh: Test B — 玻璃顆粒耐水解試驗
blocks.en: Test B: Hydrolytic Resistance of Glass Grains

blocks.zh: Test B與Test A的根本差異
blocks.en: Fundamental Difference Between Test B and Test A

blocks.zh: Test A測試容器「已處理的內表面」（包含Type II的表面處理層）；Test B測試玻璃本身材質（bulk glass）的耐水解性——破碎玻璃後，暴露出新的斷面，消除表面處理的影響。因此Test B只能反映玻璃材質本身，Type I（硼矽酸鹽）本質上耐水解，而Type II雖然內表面耐水解，但材質本身與Type III相近，Test B值會高出許多。
blocks.en: Test A tests the "treated inner surface" of the container (including the surface treatment layer of Type II); Test B tests the hydrolytic resistance of the bulk glass itself: once the glass is crushed, fresh fracture surfaces are exposed and the effect of any surface treatment is eliminated. Test B therefore reflects only the glass material. Type I (borosilicate) is inherently hydrolytically resistant, whereas Type II, although its inner surface is resistant, is similar in material to Type III, so its Test B value is much higher.

blocks.zh: 顆粒製備的關鍵步驟解析
blocks.en: Key Steps in Grain Preparation Explained

blocks.zh: 1篩選粒徑：300–425 µm（通過425 µm篩，截留於300 µm篩）——標準化粒徑確保不同批次試驗面積一致，使結果可比較。
blocks.en: 1Sieve to a grain size of 300–425 µm (passing the 425 µm sieve, retained on the 300 µm sieve). A standardized grain size ensures the same surface area from batch to batch, so results are comparable.

blocks.zh: 2磁鐵除鐵——碎磨過程中鋼製工具可能釋出鐵屑，鐵屑會干擾萃取（鹼性離子環境中鐵可能氧化反應），必須去除。
blocks.en: 2Remove iron with a magnet. Steel tools can shed iron particles during crushing, and these interfere with extraction (iron may react by oxidation in an alkaline environment), so they must be removed.

blocks.zh: 3丙酮超音波清洗——去除玻璃顆粒表面的有機污染物（手油、粉塵），確保只測量玻璃本身的溶出。
blocks.en: 3Ultrasonic cleaning in acetone. This removes organic contaminants (skin oils, dust) from the grain surface, ensuring that only dissolution from the glass itself is measured.

blocks.zh: 4140°C乾燥20 min——去除殘留丙酮和吸附水分，確保稱量10.00 g的準確性（水分影響重量）。
blocks.en: 4Dry at 140°C for 20 min. This removes residual acetone and adsorbed moisture, ensuring that the 10.00 g is weighed accurately (moisture affects the weight).

blocks.zh:
Test B關鍵參數對比Test A

試驗液：50 mL 水R1（固定）
高壓滅菌保溫：30 min（Test A為60 min）
滴定酸：0.02 M HCl（Test A用0.01 M HCl）
結果單位：mL/g玻璃（Test A為mL/100 mL試驗液）
換算係數：1 mL 0.02 M HCl ≡ 620 µg Na₂O

Type I限度：≤ 0.1 mL/g
Type II/III限度：≤ 0.85 mL/g
blocks.en:
Key Test B Parameters Compared with Test A

Test solution: 50 mL water R1 (fixed)
Autoclave hold: 30 min (60 min for Test A)
Titration acid: 0.02 M HCl (Test A uses 0.01 M HCl)
Result unit: mL/g glass (Test A: mL/100 mL test solution)
Conversion factor: 1 mL 0.02 M HCl ≡ 620 µg Na₂O

Type I limit: ≤ 0.1 mL/g
Type II/III limit: ≤ 0.85 mL/g

blocks.zh: Test B可分辨Type I vs Type II/III
blocks.en: Test B Distinguishes Type I from Type II/III

blocks.zh: Test B的限度設計非常關鍵：Type I的限度（≤0.1 mL/g）遠嚴於Type II/III（≤0.85 mL/g），且中間沒有重疊——這是因為Type I的化學組成（硼矽酸鹽）本質耐水解，而Type II雖然內表面測試（Test A）結果佳，但其材質（鈉鈣玻璃）與Type III一樣，Test B結果與Type III相近。如果某容器Test B <0.1 mL/g → 認定為Type I材質；若Test B 0.1–0.85 mL/g → 材質為Type II或III（需再由Test A或C區分）。
blocks.en: The design of the Test B limits is critical: the Type I limit (≤0.1 mL/g) is far stricter than that of Type II/III (≤0.85 mL/g), with no overlap between them. This is because the chemical composition of Type I (borosilicate) is inherently hydrolytically resistant, whereas Type II, although it performs well in the inner-surface test (Test A), is made of soda-lime glass like Type III, so its Test B result is close to that of Type III. If a container gives Test B <0.1 mL/g, the material is judged to be Type I; if Test B is 0.1–0.85 mL/g, the material is Type II or III (to be distinguished further by Test A or C).

blocks.zh: 20%重現性規則
blocks.en: The 20% Reproducibility Rule

blocks.zh: Test B使用2份獨立樣品（各10.00 g），若兩份結果之差超過最高值的20%，需要重複試驗。這反映了玻璃碎磨過程中粒徑均勻性和表面積的可變性——需要足夠的重現性才能信任結果。
blocks.en: Test B uses two independent samples (10.00 g each). If the difference between the two results exceeds 20% of the higher value, the test must be repeated. This reflects the variability of grain-size uniformity and surface area in the crushing process: sufficient reproducibility is needed before the result can be trusted.
